lines: Śakti-abiding not indeed him there; division but oṃ-ending-going; in this principle-rising therefore day-night three-by-three.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śaktisthaṃ naiva taṃ tatra vibhāgastvoṃnamontagaḥ asmiṃstattvodaye tasmādahorātrastriśastriśaḥ
